## Testing modified gravity with genetic algorithms

**Instituto de Física Teórica (IFT UAM–CSIC), Madrid · April–June 2026**

I helped develop the methodology and implemented the modified-gravity framework in the genetic algorithm pipeline. I carried out theoretical and numerical analysis to test which departures from the Hu–Sawicki model satisfy viability conditions and fit background observations.

**Collaborators:** Savvas Nesseris, Matteo Martinelli and Chiara De Leo.  
**Output:** [Exploring Hu-Sawicki-like modified gravity with Genetic Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.12745).

## Reconstructing the late-time expansion history

**Sapienza University of Rome and University of Sheffield · March 2025**

I derived analytical expressions for a cosmographic expansion around arbitrary pivot redshifts and developed a numerical workflow in Cobaya to fit the resulting parameters across redshift bins. I ran parallel fits and checked whether the results were robust to choices in the analysis.

**Collaborators:** William Giarè and Eleonora Di Valentino.  
**Output:** [Cosmographic Footprints of Dynamical Dark Energy](https://doi.org/10.3847/2041-8213/ae2917).

## A reusable pipeline for testing late-time cosmology

**University of Sheffield · March 2024**

During a COST Action CosmoVerse Short-Term Scientific Mission, I developed a Cobaya-based workflow to compare late-time models against supernovae, baryon acoustic oscillations and cosmic chronometers. I reused it for the subsequent cosmography project.

**Collaborators:** Eleonora Di Valentino and William Giarè.  
**Support:** COST Action CA21136 CosmoVerse.

## Exploring the Hubble tension and inflation

**Sapienza University of Rome and University of Rome Tor Vergata · 2023–2026**

In my doctoral research, I combined analytical modelling and Bayesian inference to investigate extensions of $\Lambda$CDM. In one project, we tested whether bulk viscosity in matter within an $f(R)$ gravity model could accommodate a higher $H_0$ while remaining compatible with supernova and DESI BAO observations. I also investigated inflationary dynamics in metric $f(R)$ gravity.

**Selected outputs:** [Viscous matter in modified gravity](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dark.2026.102486) · [Investigating $f(R)$-inflation](https://doi.org/10.1088/1475-7516/2026/07/006).
